title: FBI Photo B1
what_is_it: A still photograph captured by a U.S. military imaging system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The extracted source text is almost entirely unintelligible — it appears to be garbled OCR output from heavily redacted HUD overlay data, making independent textual analysis impossible.
The image was pre-redacted by the submitting agency before AARO received it, meaning AARO itself may not have seen the full original.
No mission report accompanied the image, so there is no operational context, flight path, altitude, speed, or sensor metadata available.
The date '12131991' visible in the HUD is confirmed incorrect, so no reliable timestamp exists for the event.
All descriptive facts about the image content come from the war.gov narrative description, not from readable source text within the PDF itself.
Single-source submission with no corroborating sensor data, radar tracks, or witness statements provided.

key_facts.value: 12131991 appears in garbled OCR text but is flagged as incorrect system date
